title: data for contact.opted_out
description: A contact joined the business opt-out (suppression) list: they sent SAIR/PARAR/STOP/CANCELAR/DESCADASTRAR/REMOVER on WhatsApp (source=keyword), or the integrator added them via POST /v1/opt-outs or the panel. From now on Meshio refuses templates to this contact from this business (POLICY_BLOCKED recipient_opted_out) and revokes the live consent. Emitted once per entry.

channel_id.description: Channel that received the keyword (null for API/panel).

keyword.description: Keyword received, upper case (e.g. SAIR), when source=keyword.
